edits.reason: Time label inconsistent with style guide; locative case (-де) matches 'kешке/түстен кейін' used elsewhere as time markers.
Typographical error — word broken with spurious spaces. Now reads as single word 'Aktau promenade' with possessive.
Idiomatic '-де жатып' = 'while still in (place)'. Ablative '-ден' would mean 'lying from Helsinki', which is wrong; locative matches fi 'Helsingistä käsin' meaning while still in Helsinki.
Style guide specifies 'кешке' (in the evening) for time markers.
Possessive '-ы' makes it 'its operator arranges' (referring to nothing). fi/en/ru subject is plain 'operator'.

edits.before: БАК-қа күндізгі сапар — шекара аймағына рұқсат пен такси қажет
edits.after: БАК-қа бір күндік сапар — шекаралық аймаққа рұқсат пен такси қажет
edits.reason: 'күндізгі сапар' = daytime trip; correct term for 'day trip' is 'бір күндік сапар' (used consistently elsewhere in file). Also style guide: 'border zone' = 'шекаралық аймақ', not 'шекара аймағы'.
For boarding a train Kazakh idiom uses 'мінер алдында' (before boarding); 'отырар алдында' (before sitting) doesn't convey the boarding sense.
fi/en/ru say 'avoid the Old Town'. 'тоқтамаңыз' (don't stop) doesn't match 'avoid'; idiomatic 'X-дан аулақ болу' = stay away from X.
fi 'kazakkien' = plural genitive (the Kazakhs'). Singular 'қазақтың' is awkward when referring to the people as a whole; plural 'қазақтардың' is correct.
Same as day 1: locative case for time markers per style guide.
'үйге сақтау' (save to home, allative) is a calque from fi 'kotia varten säästä'. Natural Kazakh uses 'үйге апаруға сақтап қою' (save to take home).
'Поштаға жүктеу' (download to mail) is awkward and ambiguous (could mean physical post). Explicit 'electronic mail' + 'save' verb matches intent.

uncertainties: Day 13 (line 1345/1484): 'маусымда маусым жабық' has double 'маусым' (June + season). It reads slightly awkwardly but is technically correct; left as-is to preserve translator's phrasing.
Day 5 (line 568): 'Yandex Go немесе жергілікті жүргізушіні Саура шатқалына шақырыңыз' — accusative only on second object is mildly awkward but parses OK.
Day 7 (line 762): kept transliteration 'БАК' for BAO (Big Almaty Lake). Could alternatively use 'БАО' matching Russian, but 'БАК' is the Kazakh-native acronym (Үлкен Алматы Көлі).
Day 12 alternatives day-13 (`Артем базары`) — kept Russian spelling without 'ё'; some sources use 'Артём'. Left as-is.
Did not unify 'қонақ үй' vs 'қонақүй' spelling — both forms appear; this is a stylistic choice, not an error.
